records.deidentified_narrative: the parking lot of food king store is a private property located at the [roadway]. the pedestrian was exiting the store to his vehicle located on the northbound of the parking lot while pushing a grocery cart. the pedestrian was crossing the crosswalk designated to pedestrians. unit 1 was traveling southbound on the parking lot of food king when he intented to make a right turn. unit 1 hit the pedestrian's grocery cart causing the pedestrian to twist his left wrist. unit 1 exited the vehicle and asked the pedestrian if he was okay. due to a language barrier the pedestrian and the unit 1 driver were not able to communicate and unit 1 left the scene. the pedestrian returned to his residence and then noticed that his left wrist was hurting. the pedestrian then returned to the scene and called 911. the pedestrian refused medical attention. the pedestrian was advised and issued an incident case card. the pedestrian then left the scene. unit 1 driver and occupants arrived at the scene a short time after. after a thorough investigation, the investigator determined that unit 1 failed to yield the right of way to the pedestrian. unit 1 was advised and issued an incident case card.

sidewalk adjacent to the crosswalk for [roadway]. one of the students was later identified as juan molina, a witness to this collision. while waiting at the crosswalk, juan said the pedestrian signal had about 10seconds displayed when another student, later identified as harold ingram, ran past him and began to cross the intersection. juan said at the same time, a vehicle which was stopped to turn from northbound parkwood onto eastbound stonebrook began to make her turn after looking both ways for traffic. juan said harold was struck by the front of the vehicle and knocked to the ground where he rolled back. harold then stood up and looked back at the female driver who was now stopped. juan said harold waived her off as though he was okay and continued across the intersection. the driver then pulled away. juan did not see the driver roll down her window to say anything. harold said when he stepped into the cross walk with time left on the pedestrian cross signal he was immediately struck by the black suv driven by a white female. harold said it knocked him to the ground where he skimmed up his left forearm and bruised his right hip. harold said he stood up and noticed the female looking at him with her window rolled up. harold then continued across [school facility]. the driver of the black suv was later identified as jennifer madrid. jennifer said she pulled up to the [roadway] to turn right onto eastbound stonebrook. jennifer said she stopped and noticed a few students standing on the sidewalk waiting to cross. jennifer said she then looked left to make sure no traffic was coming then began to make a right turn when she felt the impact and noticed harold knocked to the ground. jennifer said she rolled down her window and asked ""are you okay?"" but it did not appear as though he heard her. jennifer said harold then stood up and began to limp off as she asked again ""are you okay?"" but he did not respond to either question. jennifer said she could not turn left due to traffic so she made her right [school facility] by the time she could get turned around. jennifer [school facility] where she advised them she struck a student in the intersection and left her contact [school facility] nurse. i observed an abrasion to harold's left forearm and he said he felt pain and had bruising on his right hip. i had officer t. lennington go my jennifer's residence and provide her with a witness statement and survey the vehicle for [school facility] cameras to see if there was any video and determined there are no camera angles which would observe the collision scene. i inspected the intersection and noticed clearly posted pedestrian led crossing signals with a sign that says only to start crossing when the walk indicator is showing and not to start crossing if there is a time remaining clock showing. the time counts own starting with 44seconds.

records.deidentified_narrative: police responded to the heb parking lot at [roadway] for a pedestrian and motor vehicle accident major. when i arrived pedestrian (p1) was being evaluated by ems. i made contact with p1 who stated he was walking out of heb on the crosswalk when he was hit on the left side by unit 1. p1 stated he saw unit 1, but believed the driver of unit 1 was going to stop. p1 was complaining of chest pain and neck/head pain. p1 was conscious and was able to communicate with police and ems without issues. i didn't observe any physical injuries while speaking to p1. ems did not report any life threatening injuries at [medical facility], by ems #17 with possible internal injuries. i then contacted the driver of unit 1 who stated he did not see p1 crossing the crosswalk due to the sun shinning in his eyes. the driver of unit 1 stated he was going approximately 5-10mph. the driver of unit 1 believes he clipped p1, due to his right front bumper coming detached. i observed unit 1's right side front bumper which was slightly coming detached without any major damage. unit 1 was operable with minor damage; however, the driver of unit 1 reported he had no vehicle insurance while operating on private property. i contacted tid det. coronado #2580 and provided him with the details and p1's injuries. per tid, they would not be making the crash scene. tid advised to complete a crash report as well issue a traffic ticket for no insurance to the driver of unit 1. based on my crash investigation unit 1 failed to yield to p1 who was using the crosswalk on private property. the driver of unit 1 was issued a traffic citation #[identifier] for no liability insurance. additionally, the driver of unit 1 remained on scene and was cooperative with the investigation without any further issues. sapd [case id]. dme available

records.public_safe_text: police responded to the heb parking lot at [roadway] for a pedestrian and motor vehicle accident major. when i arrived pedestrian (p1) was being evaluated by ems. i made contact with p1 who stated he was walking out of heb on the crosswalk when he was hit on the left side by unit 1. p1 stated he saw unit 1, but believed the driver of unit 1 was going to stop. p1 was complaining of chest pain and neck/head pain. p1 was conscious and was able to communicate with police and ems without issues. i didn't observe any physical injuries while speaking to p1. ems did not report any life threatening injuries at [medical facility], by ems #17 with possible internal injuries. i then contacted the driver of unit 1 who stated he did not see p1 crossing the crosswalk due to the sun shinning in his eyes. the driver of unit 1 stated he was going approximately 5-10mph. the driver of unit 1 believes he clipped p1, due to his right front bumper coming detached. i observed unit 1's right side front bumper which was slightly coming detached without any major damage. unit 1 was operable with minor damage; however, the driver of unit 1 reported he had no vehicle insurance while operating on private property. i contacted tid det. coronado #2580 and provided him with the details and p1's injuries. per tid, they would not be making the crash scene. tid advised to complete a crash report as well issue a traffic ticket for no insurance to the driver of unit 1. based on my crash investigation unit 1 failed to yield to p1 who was using the crosswalk on private property. the driver of unit 1 was issued a traffic citation #[identifier] for no liability insurance. additionally, the driver of unit 1 remained on scene and was cooperative with the investigation without any further issues. sapd [case id]. dme available
